# PLA vs ABS vs PETG: A Comparison of 3D Printing Filaments
## Comparing PLA, ABS, and PETG
### Environmental Impact
ABS, being a petroleum-based plastic, has a higher environmental impact compared to PLA. The production of ABS relies on a nonrenewable resource whose extraction consumes substantial energy and generates emissions. Furthermore, ABS is not biodegradable, and its disposal in landfills can contribute to environmental pollution. Although ABS can be recycled, the recycling process is energy-intensive and not as widely accessible as recycling for other plastics like PET. These factors make ABS a less environmentally friendly option compared to PLA and PETG.

## Abstract
Three-dimensional (3D) printing is an additive manufacturing process that increases in application and consumer popularity.
